3_THE_BIGGEST_GAP_MEASURED.mechanism_in_the_file: src/juice/fluid.js ~line 2013: `sz = base * low * Math.exp((1.9 - 1.0*filmness) * w**(3.0 - 1.6*filmness))`. At filmness -> 1 (a cleave, which is what every melon beat and the hero are) the exponent multiplier collapses to 0.9, so the ENTIRE draw spans e^0.9 = 2.46x in radius = 6.0x in area. area_p95_over_median cannot exceed ~6 by construction and measures 2.66-4.69 after the alpha profile clips the small end. The plate wants 5.5-8.4. The file's own comment at that line still cites 'area p95/median 4.5 against plate-01's 8.3' as an aspiration; it has been 2.7-4.7 for three rounds.
3_THE_BIGGEST_GAP_MEASURED.why_this_and_not_the_interior: The interior is now real (section 1). What is left is that a real spray is a POPULATION -- hundreds of sub-pixel grains under a handful of fat beads -- and ours is ~60 objects of nearly one size. That fails in motion as well as in a still, which by the calibration is exactly what stands between 70 and 80.

4_WHAT_FAILS_IN_A_STILL_THAT_WOULD_NOT_F.the_defect: The ligament / torn-sheet morphology now renders as a PERIODIC SCALLOPED ZIPPER -- a chain of congruent lobes with a hard, aliased, one-pixel bright outline and a dark axis. Nothing in either plate has a repeating congruent lobe chain; it is the single most synthetic object in the frame.
4_WHAT_FAILS_IN_A_STILL_THAT_WOULD_NOT_F.where_to_look: shots/r8/00-hero.png at (820,560)-(1000,660) viewed at 7x: a six-lobe beaded chain at ~(890,620) and a ten-tooth 'comb' at ~(900,600). Also (390,430)-(540,560). Present in the clean render too: /tmp/critr8/CUR-00-hero.png around (860,300) and (800,470). The r7 hero has none -- shots/r7/00-hero.png (380,180)-(700,420) at 4x shows smooth tapered slivers.
4_WHAT_FAILS_IN_A_STILL_THAT_WOULD_NOT_F.mechanism_confirmed_in_source: fluid.js:763 the ligament branch sets `qn = |c.x| / prof` where `prof` carries a cosine neck field of 2..6 beads ALONG the thread. r8's optical interior is gated on `opt = smoothstep(0.16, 0.52, big)` -- size only, never on `morph` -- so `ring = exp(-((1-qs)/rw)^2)` and the radial alpha `aRad` are evaluated on that periodic transverse coordinate. The result is a bright rim that pinches once per neck: a zipper. The builder's report asserts 'a thread IS a cylinder, so a bright edge and a dark axis is the correct answer there as well'. A cylinder's rim is TWO straight edges; this coordinate makes them scallop.
4_WHAT_FAILS_IN_A_STILL_THAT_WOULD_NOT_F.in_motion: At 120 Hz with any camera or particle motion these smear into streaks and read as ligaments. Frozen, they read as a centipede. This is the classic still-only tell and it is worth ~2 points, not the round.

6_PORTRAIT_215x466_t2_THE_SHIPPING_CONFI.finding: The round-8 juice work is essentially INVISIBLE in portrait, and it is a resolution effect, not a bug in fluid.js. droplets on shots/r8-iphone: 04-cut+250ms mask_px 149 / 3 blobs (r7-iphone 154 / 3); 15-fast-flick mask_px 182 and ZERO blobs above the 12-px floor (r7 186 / 0); 16-slow-cleave 70 px / 1 blob (r7 140 / 3). Against landscape's 2397 / 40 on the same beat with only 2.3x the pixels. The entire optical-interior model is gated on `opt = smoothstep(0.16, 0.52, big)` and at 215x466 almost no droplet reaches big = 0.16, so portrait renders r7's flat fill by construction.
6_PORTRAIT_215x466_t2_THE_SHIPPING_CONFI.not_a_defect_I_am_scoring_here: tintlaw on r8-iphone/15-fast-flick reads sat_small 0.1508, sat_blob_mean 0.1162 -- the achromatic aerosol survives the small raster, which is the property that matters most in portrait. The gate is defensible physics (a 1-px drop is a Mie scatterer). But it means the piece's round-8 deliverable does not ship on the configuration we ship, and the next round should size `opt` off SCREEN-SPACE radius rather than the world-space `big` so a 3-px portrait bead gets the same treatment a 3-px landscape bead gets.
6_PORTRAIT_215x466_t2_THE_SHIPPING_CONFI.no_portrait_only_juice_bug_found: I looked for one specifically. 09-combo+50ms portrait is the only portrait frame with a real droplet population (mask_px 3975, 17 blobs, area_p95_over_median 44.96) and nothing about it is inconsistent with the landscape behaviour.

fix: src/juice/fluid.js, the spray size law at ~line 2013. Change `Math.exp((1.9 - 1.0 * filmness) * Math.pow(w, 3.0 - 1.6 * filmness))` to `Math.exp((1.9 - 0.35 * filmness) * Math.pow(w, 3.0 - 1.6 * filmness))` and, in the SAME edit, drop `base` from `(0.0085 + 0.050 * filmness)` to `(0.0085 + 0.030 * filmness)`. The first widens a cleave's radius span from e^0.9 = 2.46x to e^1.55 = 4.7x (6.0x -> 22x in area, which is the only way area_p95_over_median can reach the plate's 5.5-8.4 -- it is currently capped at ~6 by construction); the second holds the median where it is so the frame does not simply get fatter. Both are CPU-side scalars in an existing draw: zero draw calls, zero programs, zero ALU.
